title: Add validate_skill MCP tool to check skill files against the skill schema
description: There is no tool to validate skill files against the skill schema. Skills may be incomplete, missing required sections, or inconsistent with the schema without any detection. The .moeb/skills/ directory currently contains only a README with no project-level skill files present, and the bundled skills in assets/skills/ have not been validated since the skill schema was introduced. Previously proposed as a CLI command; reframed as an MCP tool since all harness commands are migrating to MCP (per a1000039).
proposed_resolution: Implement a validate_skill MCP tool that accepts a skill file path (or 'all'), reads the skill file(s) from assets/skills/ and .moeb/skills/, parses each against the skill schema, and returns a structured report of missing or invalid fields using the pass/fail format. Integrate as an optional step in the run review phase under a skill_schema_compliance rubric.
